Whither Goeth Agricultural Economics?
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the reasons why agricultural and applied economics and similar departments are often stand‐alone academic units. The factors that affect and shape the relationship of agricultural and applied economics faculty and departments with those from general economics departments are discussed. We present case studies of three universities having different relationships with general economics faculty at their respective universities: a merged unit, an unmerged unit, and a never‐merged unit. We conclude with rationale for the existence and future trajectory of agricultural economics and related academic units at Land Grant Universities.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了为何农业与应用经济学及类似院系往往是独立的学术单位。我们探讨了影响并塑造农业与应用经济学教师及院系与普通经济学院系之间关系的各种因素。我们选取了与普通经济学教师关系各不相同的三所大学进行案例研究：合并型单位、未合并型单位以及从未合并型单位。最后，我们阐述了赠地大学中农业经济学及相关学术单位存在的理由与未来发展走向。

How Women Saved Agricultural Economics
abstract: Women entered agricultural economics in numbers starting in the 1980s, and their ranks are increasing over time. We make the case that women have increased the relevance in the field of agricultural economics through their diverse interests, perspectives, and experiences. We document how women have changed the profession of agricultural economics in both academia and government. In research, women have expanded the field's treatment of non‐traditional topics such as food safety and nutrition and environmental and natural resource economics. In this sense, women saved the profession from a future as a specialty narrowly focused on agricultural production and markets.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪80年代起，女性大量进入农业经济学领域，其人数随时间推移不断增加。我们认为，女性凭借多元的兴趣、视角与经验，提升了农业经济学的相关性。我们记录了女性如何改变了农业经济学在学术界和政府部门的专业面貌。在研究领域，女性拓展了该学科对食品安全与营养、环境与自然资源经济学等非传统议题的关注。从这一意义上说，女性使该专业免于沦为一门狭隘专注于农业生产与市场的专业领域。

abstract: This article analyzes factors that predict the academic rank of Economics and Agricultural Economics faculty. While female faculties are under‐represented in both types of academic departments, we find that significant factors in predicting the academic rank of female faculty are primarily professional contributions represented by publications and experience. Agricultural Economics departments require more publications than Economics in order to achieve the same positive effect on the latent indicator of higher academic rank. The positive contribution of publications to higher academic rank status is larger for females than for males for both types of economists. The result is suggestive of potential benefits relating to policies that support women in their ability to publish.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了预测经济学与农业经济学教师学术职称的因素。尽管女性教师在两类院系中均代表不足，但我们发现，预测女性教师学术职称的重要因素主要是以论文发表和工作经验体现的专业贡献。农业经济学院系需要比经济学院系更多的论文发表，才能在潜在的较高学术职称指标上取得同样的正向效果。对于两类经济学家而言，论文发表对更高学术职称的正向贡献，对女性都大于男性。这一结果表明，支持女性发表论文的政策可能具有潜在益处。

Crude Oil and the Libyan Economy
venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
abstract: Oil is the primary source of income in the Libyan economy; hence, it is important to more fully understand the economic factors associated with this sector of the economy. We applied a recent growth theory model to develop a better understanding of the relationship among capital, labor, domestic consumption of oil, oil exports and gross domestic product (GDP) in the Libyan economy. A log linear model was estimated using annual data for the period 1980 to 2012. All of the coefficients were significant at the 0.05 level except the log of labor, which was significant at the 0.0613 level. The signs associated with the variables were consistent with economic theory. The adjusted R square was 0.912 indicating that approximately 91 percent of variation in GDP was explained by the independent variables. There was only limited multicollinearity in the model as all Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) values were less than 10. Breusch Pagan and Anderson-Darling test results indicated a constant variance and that the errors were normally distributed, respectively. Similarly, the Durbin-Watson statistic indicated an absence of autocorrelation at the 0.05 level. The resulting elasticities were positive and strongly inelastic, indicating that large changes in each of the variables would be required to dramatically increase GDP. Nevertheless, it is clear that oil will continue to play a leading future economic growth and development.
abstract_zh: 石油是利比亚经济的主要收入来源，因此，更全面地理解与该部门相关的经济因素十分重要。我们运用一个较新的增长理论模型，研究利比亚经济中资本、劳动力、国内石油消费、石油出口与国内生产总值（GDP）之间的关系。我们利用1980至2012年的年度数据估计了对数线性模型。除劳动力的对数项在0.0613水平上显著外，所有系数在0.05水平上均显著。各变量的符号与经济理论一致。调整后的R²为0.912，表明GDP变动的约91%可由自变量解释。模型中仅存在有限的多重共线性，所有方差膨胀因子（VIF）均小于10。Breusch-Pagan检验与Anderson-Darling检验结果分别表明误差项具有同方差性并服从正态分布。同样，Durbin-Watson统计量在0.05水平上表明不存在自相关。所得弹性为正且高度缺乏弹性，表明需要各变量发生巨大变化才能显著提高GDP。尽管如此，石油显然仍将在未来的经济增长与发展中继续发挥主导作用。

abstract: This paper analyzes a reward system that uses a club good to promote recycling. In particular, we examine a context of incomplete information in which the administrator is unable to observe the resident’s attitude towards recycling. The results suggest that despite the lack of information, the administrator is able to induce all types of residents to recycle when the reward is sufficiently high. Furthermore, we show that education programs, technologies that help to reduce the residential recycling cost and penalties for garbage dumping are complementary tools that could also promote recycling.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一种利用俱乐部物品来促进回收的奖励制度。具体而言，我们考察了一种信息不完全的情形，即管理者无法观察到居民对回收的态度。结果表明，尽管信息缺乏，只要奖励足够高，管理者仍能激励所有类型的居民进行回收。此外，我们表明，教育项目、降低居民回收成本的技术以及对乱扔垃圾的惩罚，是可以相互补充的工具，同样能够促进回收。
